text:
```yaml
name: Moq FFI Hops-Based Broadcast Routing

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Rust
      uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
      with:
        toolchain: stable
        profile: minimal
        override: true

    - name: Build and test
      run: cargo test --all

    - name: Run tests with hops-based broadcast routing
      run: cargo test --package moq-ffi --features hops-broadcast-routing

    - name: Upload test results
      uses: mikepenz/action-junit-report@v4
      with:
        token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        report_paths: 'target/debug/deps/*.xml'
        check_name: 'Moq FFI Hops-Based Broadcast Routing Tests'

    - name: Check just
      run: ./scripts/just.sh check
```
